finding_reviews.rationale: Coverage matches (Bonterra PIK term loan, Mavenlink revolver). Mavenlink revolver: printed 'S + 0.00 %' with no PIK, as filed. Bonterra not supported: the page prints '(S + 0.00 %; 8.00 % PIK)' at 12.35 %; the same loan with the same printed terms publishes spread 8.0 at 2024-03-31 (13.30 %) and 0.0 here. A zero cash margin cannot be a total margin that includes an 8.00 PIK, so under D-031 the zero is not the margin. The D-031 all-in test that set these spreads is unsound as a test of the spread: its CONTRADICTED class ('cash-only fits') shows only that the printed rate is the cash coupon, which is this repo's interest_rate storage convention, not that the PIK lies outside the margin. Where the printed PIK exceeds the printed cash margin the cash margin cannot be a total that includes the PIK, so the withdrawn D-031 spread was right. Same-filing pairs with identical printed terms show the filer prints all-in on one line and cash on the next (GHA Buyer 2023-03-31: term loan 13.30 %, delayed draw 9.55 %, both 'S + 4.50 %; 3.75 % PIK'; the build now publishes 8.25 and 4.50 for the same terms). The report's own observation pik-rate-holds-margin-when-whole-coupon-is-pik says spread 8 was left for this quarter; rfabe publishes 0.0. At best source_ambiguity (the parked D-232 whole-coupon reading), not false_alarm.
